description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ValueProviderBase' for custom value providers in a Spring Shell-based CLI application. It provides a common implementation for autocompletion logic based on a list of possible values, which subclasses must supply.

classes.name: ValueProviderBase
classes.description: Abstract class extending Spring Shell's ValueProviderSupport to provide autocompletion functionality based on a customizable list of values.

methods.name: getAllPossibleValues
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to supply all possible string values for autocompletion based on the method parameter.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Provides a list of CompletionProposal objects for autocompletion; filters possible values based on the current input prefix.
